subject: Clarify SOC 2 Type II coverage: snapshot cutoffs and bridge letter availability
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightview.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightview.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage and snapshot inclusivity question

Hi Aditya,

We're preparing our vendor assessment for the upcoming BrightView board review and need to confirm a couple of details about Redwood's SOC 2 Type II package before we sign off. Can you please confirm the following items?

1) Report period: Does the attached SOC 2 Type II (SOC2_TypeII_2024-07_to_2025-06.pdf) cover controls for the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 inclusive? In particular, is a point-in-time snapshot taken at 2025-06-30 00:00:00 UTC considered in-scope for evidence of operating effectiveness?

2) Point-in-time evidence: Our auditors will want to know whether system snapshots (DB backups, object-store manifests, audit-log indexes) captured at the final day of the period are treated as in-period evidence. If some evidence types are only retained as rolling snapshots (e.g., daily backups, 00:00 UTC), please call that out.

3) Bridge letter: If our procurement window requires coverage through 2025-12-31, can Redwood provide a bridge letter or an interim attestation to cover the gap between 2025-06-30 and 2025-12-31? If yes, what is the typical lead time and who at your auditor should we coordinate with (we copy AuditServices above)?

We appreciate a brief confirmation and any docs you can provide for our auditor.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
InfoSec Manager, BrightView Health
Samantha.Lee@brightview.com

--
BrightView Security Team
From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightview.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@auditservices.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage and snapshot inclusivity question

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then details and next steps:

1) Report period: Confirmed — the attached SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 inclusive. The auditor's testing window and management's assertions treat 2025-06-30 as the end-of-period date.

2) Point-in-time evidence: Yes — point-in-time artifacts captured at 2025-06-30 00:00:00 UTC are considered in-scope where they match the control's evidence type. For clarity:
- Production DB backups: nightly backups occur at 00:00 UTC and the 2025-06-30 snapshot is preserved as a named daily backup; that backup was part of auditor sampling for CC6/Change Management controls.
- S3 object-store manifests and object versioning: manifests taken on 2025-06-30 are retained; object-version history is available and was provided as part of evidence.
- Audit logs (ingested into ELK / long-term store): daily indices are rolled at 00:00 UTC; indices containing 2025-06-30 events were included in the evidence set.

Note: Some ephemeral caches (in-memory caches and ephemeral worker artifacts) are not retained as long-running snapshots — auditors rely on persistent backups, logs, and change records for those control tests.

3) Bridge letter: We can request a bridge letter from our auditor (AuditServices, Inc.). Typical process:
- We escalate to the audit partner and request a short-form bridge letter confirming that no material changes affecting controls occurred since 2025-06-30.
- Lead time is usually 5–10 business days once the auditor accepts the request and we provide a short evidence pack.
- Contact at auditor: Tom Ruiz (copied) can confirm exact turnaround and scope.

I've attached the SOC 2 PDF we referenced and an evidence manifest (evidence_manifest_2025-06-30.csv) that maps control IDs to artifact filenames. Marissa (compliance) and Vivek (security ops) are looped in if you or your auditors need any additional technical exhibits.

Next steps:
- Samantha: let us know whether BrightView will accept a bridge letter for procurement, or whether you require an interim assessment.
- Tom / AuditServices: please confirm expected lead time and whether you need any expanded artifact sets (e.g., raw DB backup checksums, S3 object digests).

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2024-07_to_2025-06.pdf; evidence_manifest_2025-06-30.csv
From: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@auditservices.io>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightview.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage and snapshot inclusivity question

Thanks — Tom from AuditServices here. Quick note on process:

We can provide a bridge letter that states the auditor's position regarding continuity of controls from 2025-06-30 through a requested bridge date (e.g., 2025-12-31). To prepare that letter we typically need:
- Confirmation of any production changes since 2025-06-30 that could affect control design or operation (major infra changes, control owners changed, onboarding of new 3rd-party subservice orgs).
- The evidence manifest that Aditya provided is helpful; for a short-form bridge letter we will often ask for checksums for retained backups and a short statement from the security ops lead that no material control failures have occurred (one paragraph).

Turnaround: assuming no significant scope expansion, 5 business days after we receive the requested confirmations is realistic. If BrightView prefers an interim attestation instead of a bridge letter, that will require additional sampling and will take longer (2–3 weeks).

Happy to coordinate directly with Marissa and Vivek for the artifacts.

Cheers,
Tom Ruiz
Senior Manager, AuditServices, Inc.
engage@auditservices.io
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage and snapshot inclusivity question

Hi Samantha / Tom — placing this on our compliance tracker and confirming next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll prepare the short control-continuity statement for AuditServices (one paragraph signed by Compliance) and attach checksums for the 2025-06-30 named DB backup and S3 manifest.
2) Vivek will confirm there were no major infra migrations or onboarding of new subservice providers affecting controls in the window 2025-06-30 -> 2025-12-31.
3) Tom — once we upload the artifact bundle to the secure upload link (I will share a Drive link and a one-time SFTP if needed), please confirm the expected letter template and where we should send the signed request.

I'll aim to get the compliance statement and artifacts to AuditServices within 48 hours. If BrightView confirms acceptance of a bridge letter (rather than interim attestation) we should meet your procurement timing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
